notes.title: Troubleshooting Announcement
notes.content:
[h3]Hello Envoys of Gaia![/h3][p]Some players may encounter issues entering the game under certain circumstances,
Please refer to the following cases and perform the corresponding actions to try troubleshooting![/p][h3]Login window does not appear[/h3][p]This may be due to missing Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable in your OS, causing login issues.
If this happens, you can download and install the corresponding package to initially troubleshoot the issue.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45566423/60caaf3e997ce86efd25efcc3c4d61ba6bb151a4.jpg"][/img] [/p][p]Players can follow the instructions to proceed!![/p][p]1. Use the built-in installer in our setup file.
2. Download from the [url="https://learn.microsoft.com/zh-tw/cpp/windows/latest-supported-vc-redist?view=msvc-170"]Microsoft website[/url], file version: 2015-2022, Version number: v14.44.35208.0
(Currently the latest version).
👉(x64) version installer link: [/p][p][url="https://aka.ms/vs/17/release/vc_redist.x64.exe"]https://aka.ms/vs/17/release/vc_redist.x64.exe[/url][/p][p]
👉(x86) version installer link: [/p][p][url="https://aka.ms/vs/17/release/vc_redist.x86.exe"]https://aka.ms/vs/17/release/vc_redist.x86.exe[/url][/p][p][/p][p] [/p][p]※Due to compatibility issues, it is recommended to play the game on Windows 7 or above.[/p][h3]Error Code 99 during update[/h3][p]This issue occurs when updating game translation data, mostly due to unstable connections. Players can try switching network environments (wired, wireless, mobile, etc.) to resolve it.[/p][h3]Unexpected game crash[/h3][p]There are various causes for this issue. After a crash, the game will automatically report the error to the team for ongoing fixes. Any update information will be announced in-game.[/p][p] If the issue persists, please download the game via our [url="https://d2sk2707yaok4.cloudfront.net/AuraKingdomImpact.exe"]official link[/url].[/p][p]"Aura Kingdom - Impact" Operations Team[/p]
